subject: Enable vendor payouts: bank docs, ACH/Wire info and structured remittance mapping
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: payments@harvestcloud.com
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 4 Jul 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood next steps to enable vendor payouts & remittance mapping

Hi Li / HarvestCloud payments team,

Thanks for agreeing to move forward with Redwood's vendor onboarding. To finish activation on our side and connect payouts to POs, finance needs the items below. We try to keep the activation window to 48 business hours once we have complete materials. Please send these as attachments or a secure link: 

- Completed supplier onboarding form (PDF) with legal name and tax ID
- W-9 (or W-8 if outside US)
- Bank letter on bank letterhead confirming account ownership (PDF)
- Preferred payout channel: ACH (US), Wire (Intl), or Virtual account
- For wire transfers: SWIFT/BIC and intermediary bank details if applicable
- Remittance mapping: example CSV or sample invoice showing the fields you require to reconcile (PO number, invoice number, line-level remittance, remit-to reference). If you use a specific field name (e.g. "InvoiceRef"), call that out.

One operational item: our AP system can send structured remittance tags in the payment instructions (ISO-like key:value pairs) or include a CSV remittance file attached to the payment. Please indicate which you prefer and a sample of the format.

I've attached Redwood's vendor onboarding checklist to speed things up. Once we receive your docs and confirm the micro-deposit (for ACH) or test wire, we'll complete the payee activation and create the first PO.

Target next steps:
- You: return documents + preferred remittance format (by end of day Monday)
- Us: run micro-deposit or test wire and confirm routing
- Go-live: accept first invoice mapped to PO and confirm remittance reconciliation

Attach: payee_onboarding_checklist_redwood.pdf (see checklist item 3 for remittance examples)

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min call if helpful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Lead, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Redwood next steps to enable vendor payouts & remittance mapping

Thanks Li — got the PDFs and bank details. A couple quick clarifications before we start the ACH micro-deposit: 

1) Field name mapping: is PO_NO the same field you consider the canonical PO number? Our finance system will send structured tags like "PO:PO-44321" by default, but for CSV ingestion we can map to your PO_NO column. If possible, confirm we should send both the structured tag and the CSV with PO_NO populated.

2) Micro-deposit flow: We'll initiate two micro-deposits (random cents) to account 0471592301 within 24 hours. Please confirm once they land and provide the two amounts so we can confirm. ACH will be activated after confirmation. If you'd prefer a single test wire of $1.00 instead, tell us and we'll route that instead (wire fees may apply).

3) Invoice remittance: you indicated REMIT_NOTE — will you accept line-level descriptions in REMIT_NOTE, or do you require a separate line_item file? Our typical format is one CSV with invoice-level rows and a separate CSV for line-level detail if requested.

Plan / timeline:
- Today: Redwood initiates micro-deposit (ACH) test or wires test if requested
- Prior to first PO: confirm micro-deposit and finalize mapping; we will then activate payee and issue PO-44321 as the first PO

I've attached a short internal checklist we use for activation (payee_activation_checklist.pdf). I'll start the micro-deposit now and update once it's sent.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Payments Ops Lead
Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai

Jordan / Marissa — confirmed.

We received two small micro-deposits this morning: $0.14 and $0.67. Please confirm which amounts you recorded so we can close the activation on our side.

Regarding mapping: yes, please provide both — structured tags in the payment (PO:..., INV:...) and a CSV with PO_NO populated. REMIT_NOTE is sufficient for line-level descriptions for most invoices; we'll request a separate line_item CSV only for very large or complex invoices.

We also prefer the ACH activation; no wire required. We expect the first PO (PO-44321) to come through next Tuesday as the purchase team is finalizing the SOW. For visibility, can Redwood include the hubspot deal id in the remittance (HC-4821) so our team can reconcile to the contract?

Thanks — looking forward to the test confirmation.

Best,
Li Mei
Senior Finance Manager — Payments
HarvestCloud Inc.
